easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 25, reduced by 3 for each {1} available.
description:
If you have a life total of 4 or higher, activate Treasonous Ogre by paying 3 life, adding {R}.
Repeat step 1 until you have 3 or fewer life or until you have {8} available.
Activate Lin Sivvi's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, searching your library for Children of Korlis and putting it onto the battlefield.
Activate Children of Korlis by sacrificing it, causing you to gain life equal to the life you've lost this turn.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 once.
Activate Lin Sivvi's second ability by paying {3}, putting Children of Korlis from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Lin Sivvi.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.
